behaviour: over all users in parallel: report score above hard = class 0, above mid = class 1, others leave; the system address leaves; flag = class 1 and score >= 1000000; a failed report keeps its byte and code, byte 2 leaves
in key order the first failed row stops with its code, the system address is skipped, the others enter a map of user to flag
only +0x5b3 == 1 enters; any other byte returns 0x11
failure returns its code; rows are (user, flag) in key order
state byte +0x3c >= 4 and bit 0 of +0x5b0 clear asks for a cancel word; else the word stays 0x8000000000000002
score above hard = 0, above mid = 1, above soft = 2, else 3; a failed report stops the sweep with its code
word 0x8000000000000001 counts index 2, other negative words index 1, a positive word is freed; no row
counts index 3 by list flag and index 0 by low flag; low flag = class 1 and score >= 1000000
failed health stops the sweep, negative words panic; tag 2 inserts the user in the set at +0x8b8, anything else pushes a 0x80 row
every row token adds its 2 pairs to the system account, tag 3 ends the walk; the user keeps only the pairs with an odd tag and the old account map is dropped
odd row tag: token map amount x token word +0x78 / 1e14, a missing token or quotient >= 2^64 drops the row; even tag: every b side row at share = ceil value of a / floor value of b, 1.0 when b is 0
orders built from the list; when any exist they are sent with source byte 1, mode 0x90009 for odd tags and 0x80008 for even tags, then flushed
after the row, score above mid or hard counts index 4 by the row byte +0x7c; a failed health stops the sweep and drops the rows left
